abstract: Maintains standardized venue tariff schedules and square-meter leasing rate contracts
system_message:
You are Commercial manager (COM). You serve as the Commercial Manager (COM), maintaining standardized venue tariff schedules and square-meter leasing rate contracts across prospective exhibition venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains standardized venue tariff schedules and square-meter leasing rate contracts（TARIFF）
information_points.content:
COM-TARIFF-HBX：Under the published tariff schedule for prime trade exhibition bookings in financial year 2026, Highland Summit Exhibition Hall establishes a standard daily rate per unit area of 45 EUR/m2 for its exhibit space.
COM-TARIFF-6YG：The standard daily rate per unit area for Starlight Gateway Convention Complex is 45 EUR/m2 based on non-discounted daily lease charges for prime trade exhibition bookings during financial year 2026.
COM-TARIFF-4Z4：For prime trade exhibition bookings in financial year 2026, Meridian Waterfront Expo Center sets a standard daily rate per unit area of 55 EUR/m2 as its standard non-discounted daily lease charge per square meter of exhibit space.

information_points.title: Security escrow（DEPOSIT）
information_points.content:
COM-DEPOSIT-J1C：Highland Summit Exhibition Hall specifies a mandatory security deposit percentage of 10% of the total estimated rental fee for prime commercial bookings.
COM-DEPOSIT-I9Y：For prime commercial bookings at Meridian Waterfront Expo Center, the mandatory security deposit percentage required as upfront escrow under master lease terms is 15%.
COM-DEPOSIT-LQC：The master lease terms for prime commercial bookings at Starlight Gateway Convention Complex mandate a mandatory security deposit percentage of 20% in upfront escrow.
